goal: Reduce double scans and missed scans at a small secondhand book sale checkout.
hard_constraints: One volunteer uses an existing barcode scanner and paper tally; no new software or paid hardware.
Do not retain buyer identities or slow the queue by more than a brief check per sale.
Compare both error types and checkout time over two sale sessions without claiming the sessions are identical.
available_resources: Scanner beep, printed item stickers, till receipts and a two-session paper tally.
expected_result: A reversible checkout procedure and an inspectable small trial.

goal: Find why a school garden's manual rain gauge appears to undercount rainfall compared with a nearby public reading.
hard_constraints: Do not assume the public reading is ground truth for the garden's exact location.
No powered instruments, climbing, or changes to the public station.
Use only the existing gauge, a ruler, a marked cup and observations during the next three rain events; distinguish measurement error from local variation.
available_resources: Gauge, ruler, marked cup, site sketch and public daily rainfall report.
expected_result: A safe diagnostic sequence with uncertainty and a way to check each explanation.

goal: Make a makerspace's shared 3D printer failures easier to diagnose before wasting a full print.
hard_constraints: Keep the existing printer and approved materials; no firmware changes or extra sensors.
Do not bypass the enclosure or normal ventilation and burn precautions.
Differentiate setup, material and machine causes using at most three small test prints and record time and material use.
available_resources: Printer log, sample filament, existing calibration card and operator checklist.
expected_result: A short fault-isolation process suitable for novice operators.

goal: Reduce intermittent USB printer disconnections at a community advice office without exposing documents.
hard_constraints: One shared computer and printer; no administrator rights, new hardware or cloud upload.
Test only blank or synthetic pages and do not inspect clients' document contents.
Separate cable, power, queue and software explanations using a reversible sequence during one after-hours session.
available_resources: Existing cable, outlet, print queue view and an empty test document.
expected_result: A bounded diagnosis and a practical fallback for the next opening day.

goal: Teach twelve teenagers to distinguish map distance from travel time when planning a walking route.
hard_constraints: Use printed maps, rulers and a classroom clock; no phones or actual street crossing during the lesson.
Do not imply that a straight-line distance is a safe or accessible route.
In 35 minutes, check each learner's ability to explain scale, route choice and uncertainty.
available_resources: Two printed neighborhood maps with scales, pencils and example walking speeds.
expected_result: An accessible lesson with a short individual check.

goal: Teach beginner spreadsheet users why sorting one column can detach values from their original rows.
hard_constraints: Use a fabricated eight-row table with no personal or financial data.
Some learners have only paper, so the core exercise must work without a computer.
Within 30 minutes, assess whether learners can detect and repair a broken association, not merely repeat a rule.
available_resources: Printed sample table, scissors, sticky notes and one optional projected spreadsheet.
expected_result: A hands-on explanation and a falsifiable learning check.

goal: Help eight children explain why the Moon can appear in different shapes without confusing phases with Earth's shadow.
hard_constraints: Use one lamp and foam balls indoors; never ask children to stare into the lamp.
Do not teach that a lunar eclipse causes ordinary monthly phases.
Fit a 25-minute session and check understanding with a new Sun-Earth-Moon position.
available_resources: Lamp, foam balls, darkened room and drawing cards.
expected_result: A safe visual lesson and a transfer question.

goal: Teach new sewing volunteers to notice when seam allowance changes the finished size of a simple fabric pouch.
hard_constraints: Use scrap fabric and existing hand tools; no cutting of donated finished garments.
Do not require machine sewing or assume the same hand dexterity for every learner.
In 40 minutes, compare a prediction with a measured paper or fabric prototype and allow a non-sewing participation path.
available_resources: Scraps, paper templates, rulers, clips, needles and thread.
expected_result: A practical lesson that tests size reasoning and accommodates different abilities.

goal: Create a low-pressure public poetry activity in a covered market that invites people to combine ordinary words they overhear without recording anyone's speech.
hard_constraints: No audio recording, quotation attributed to a person, or solicitation from shoppers.
Use only a freestanding paper board for one afternoon; do not mark the building or block stalls.
Participation and display must be optional, and volunteers remove the board at closing.
available_resources: Paper cards, pencils, freestanding board and two volunteers.
expected_result: Several distinct creative formats and a small way to observe participation and comfort.

goal: Design a three-minute shadow performance for a senior center using everyday objects and no projector.
hard_constraints: One lamp and a white sheet are available; avoid darkening exits or creating trip hazards.
Audience members may have limited vision or hearing, so the story cannot rely on silhouettes alone.
Two performers have 20 minutes to set up and must leave the room as found.
available_resources: Lamp, sheet, chairs, ordinary objects and two performers.
expected_result: An expressive, repeatable performance with an inclusive audience check.

goal: Make a one-page neighborhood recipe zine that celebrates variations without presenting any family's recipe as communal property.
hard_constraints: Use only recipes volunteered for this purpose with explicit permission for the stated print run.
Do not print names, dietary claims or origin stories without separate consent and verification.
Print at most 30 black-and-white copies using an existing copier; allow contributors to withdraw before printing.
available_resources: Paper, copier, consent slips and two volunteer editors.
expected_result: An inviting editorial concept and a checkable consent and proofing process.

goal: Create a short participatory rhythm piece for a ferry terminal lounge using silent or near-silent gestures.
hard_constraints: No amplified sound, tapping on fixtures, blocking boarding signs or interrupting announcements.
Travelers can join or leave without being singled out and may participate seated.
A single facilitator must set up and clear the activity within ten minutes; test comfort with observation and an optional question.
available_resources: Printed gesture cards, portable sign and terminal staff's permitted corner.
expected_result: Distinct working forms and a reversible one-session pilot.
